name: Sable Vane
tagline: Command every vehicle you own from a single, luminous horizon.
positioning: Sable Vane brings aerospace-grade telematics to the driveways of individuals and prosumers — tracking, diagnosing, and protecting personal fleets in real time.

hero.h1: Your fleet was never meant to be invisible.
hero.sub: Sable Vane unifies your cars, trucks, boats, and RVs into one living map — with live location, engine health, and theft alerts refined for people who own their machines, not just manage them.

features.title: Live constellation map
features.description: Every vehicle you own rendered as a moving point of light — refreshed every second, whether it's in the garage or halfway across the continent.

features.title: Engine foresight
features.description: We read the OBD-II bus so you don't have to. Sable Vane surfaces a failing alternator or slipping transmission weeks before the dashboard light ever blinks.

features.title: Sovereign geofences
features.description: Draw a boundary around home, the marina, or the ski cabin. The instant a vehicle crosses it, your phone knows — and so does the record.

features.title: Guardian anti-theft
features.description: Motion at 3 a.m. triggers an immediate alert and a shareable live trail you can hand straight to police, no subscription escalation required.

features.title: The eternal logbook
features.description: Mileage, fuel, service history, and trip purpose captured automatically — the immaculate maintenance ledger your classic car deserves.

features.title: One calm dashboard
features.description: No enterprise clutter. A single, elegant view built for the person who reads it themselves, on a Sunday morning, with coffee.

testimonials.quote: I keep three classics and a work truck across two states. Before Sable Vane I tracked service on napkins. Now the whole fleet reports to me like it's mission control.
testimonials.name: Diego Marchetti

testimonials.quote: The foresight alerts caught a coolant leak on our overland rig two days before a 900-mile trip. That single warning paid for a decade of the subscription.
testimonials.name: Priya Anand

testimonials.quote: I bought it to watch my daughter's first car. I stayed for the anti-theft trail — it recovered a stolen trailer in under an hour.
testimonials.name: Wesley Okafor

pricing.blurb: For the single, cherished machine you refuse to lose sight of.
For the household or prosumer running a small, serious stable.
For the collector or operator whose horizon keeps expanding.

homepage.footerBlurb: Sable Vane — telematics with a longer view. Every vehicle you own, held in a single steady horizon.
